note: Every state this pass could NOT capture, with the mechanical reason. Sitting here is not the same as 'skipped' - each row says what specifically blocked it.

rows.what: Every Flutterwave checkout phase: content unlock 'processing'/'success'/'failed', tip sent, paid-DM pay, subscription charge, credits purchase, event ticket purchase, shop checkout. Design artboards WAWU-Content-Detail 4a/4b/4c, WAWU-Paid-DM 3a/3b/3c, WAWU-Creator-Onboarding Processing/Failed/Success, WAWU-Marketplace-Tips 8.
rows.reason: The checkout runs on Flutterwave's own hosted surface, loaded from an external script. The headless browser in this sandbox cannot resolve that host (net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED on every content page), and the local backend runs MockFlutterwaveAdapter because FLUTTERWAVE_SECRET_KEY is empty, so it hands back a placeholder public key. Reaching these needs openFlutterwaveCheckout stubbed, which changes the thing under test.
rows.impact: The entire paid path past the review sheet is UNVERIFIED. That is the app's only revenue-generating action.

rows.what: The four-phase withdraw sheet (bank picker, account resolve, confirm, result).
rows.reason: 'Withdraw to your bank' is disabled:true at a ₦0 balance, which is correct behaviour. The local Flutterwave wallet mock keys its balance by account reference in process memory with no external funding endpoint, so no test actor could be given a balance without editing backend code.
rows.impact: Withdrawal is honestly gated but wholly uncaptured.

rows.reason: It renders only when entry.outro is set, which the data carries on 31 December only. Reaching it needs the system clock forced; page.clock was not applied to this row.
rows.impact: One card of a 365-day surface never seen.

rows.what: Paid-DM thread states: awaiting/countdown, responded, refunded, and the three no-response penalty states (warning 10-30%, off 7 days 30-50%, off 30 days >50%). Design artboards WAWU-Paid-DM 4/5/6, WAWU-Creator-DM-Earnings 4a/4b/4c.
rows.reason: These are fixed per seeded thread; the local DB has one DirectMessage row that returned 'Conversation not found' for every test actor, and the penalty states are computed from a server-side response-rate history no fixture creates.
rows.impact: The paid-DM lifecycle - the second revenue stream - is UNVERIFIED end to end.

rows.what: Bills payment: category, biller, package, customer number, receipt. Nine surfaces.
rows.reason: DELIBERATE. src/app/(app)/services/pay/page.tsx sets SWITCHED_OFF=true (commit b862e1d, product owner 5 Sep 2026) and returns the ServiceComingSoon panel BEFORE any form markup - verified in the running app, the form is genuinely absent, not merely hidden. Recorded as legitimately unreachable, NOT as a defect.
rows.impact: None on this build. See finding F04 for the catalogue card that still advertises it.

rows.what: Event detail, edit, manage, scan, ticket purchase and the ticket QR.
rows.reason: The local Event table is empty (0 rows) and no fixture creates one; /events/:id, /events/:id/edit, /events/:id/manage, /events/:id/scan and /events/:id/tickets have no id to visit. TicketScanner additionally needs window.BarcodeDetector, absent in headless Chromium.
rows.impact: An entire ticketing subsystem - which CLAUDE.md says does not exist - is unverified either way.

rows.what: Resumed-from-background as a distinct entry state.
rows.reason: Not exercised. Every row in scenario-matrix.json is a COLD START with the session written to localStorage before navigation. This is a web app with no pause/resume lifecycle hook, but a returning-tab path (stale token, refresh-on-focus) exists and was not walked.
rows.impact: Token-refresh-on-resume and any focus-triggered revalidation are UNVERIFIED.

rows.reason: design/screens/WAWU Landing Page.dc.html contains NO fixed-size phone frames, so the artboard renderer produced one junk 'board-0' frame instead of screens. The mobile landing design is not renderable by the installed harness and therefore cannot be compared to anything.
rows.impact: Landing conformance on mobile is unestablishable with current tooling.

rows.reason: Every capture in this pass is the app's default (dark) presentation. No light/dark pair was produced. A defect visible only in the other theme would not have been seen.
